crossRefs.note: Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army…
Now Joab was over all the army of Israel, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites,
David said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first…
Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

parallels.note: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

people.name: Ahilud

people.name: Joab

people.name: Zeruiah
people.line: Sister of David; mother of Joab, Abishai, and Asahel
